thread:
incident-bot: Pager: SLO alert triggered for /v1/stream (p99 latency > 3s) — severity: P2 — paging oncall sara

sara: ack — joining. any customer hits?

dave: seeing p95 ~1.2s but p99 spikes to 4-6s, streaming stalls reported, spike started ~4150000000

mia: cpu on preproc hosts (preproc-*) jumped ~3x, tokenizer process `tokenize-worker` shows long GC spikes, threads blocked on template expansion

raj: adding context — noticed surge of requests in JSON-mode where tool_schema includes large `examples` arrays, prompt templating expands heavy JSON -> big string passed to tokenizer

pm-anna: customers: two large customers (acct: acme-inc, beta-bank) reported degraded UX, a few 5xx from streaming client timeouts. ops shows ~12% streaming connection failures in last 5m

sara: priority: stabilize traffic and reduce tail latency. Triage owners: eng-runtime (dave/mia) for runtime, eng-ml (raj) for tokenizer/prompt path.

ops-bot: deploys: no recent platform deploys in last 30m. autoscaler triggered +2 preproc instances at 4149999980

dave: quick checks: network looks fine, k8s nodes not saturated, disk IO normal. stack traces show `prompt_renderer` stuck ~200-300ms per request before hitting tokenizer

mia: pulling heap histo from preproc-12: `jmap` shows big String retention from template builder, JSON-mode `renderExamples()` allocates lots of intermediate strings

raj: hypothesis: JSON-mode tool schemas with large `examples` + `{{#each}}` loops trigger quadratic expansion for some templates. tokenizer sees much larger inputs -> more tokenization work and KV caching churn -> streaming stalls at tail.

pm-anna: impact: acme-inc reported 15% slower responses, beta-bank saw 8% drop in throughput. SLA isn't fully broken yet but trending. need customer communication?

sara: yes — ask CS to notify impacted customers with ETA. For now we need mitigations.

dave: mitigation plan proposal: 1) enable request-side rate limit for JSON-mode routes (soft throttle), 2) temporarily disable heavy example expansion via runtime feature flag `preproc.template_example_limit=20`, 3) route streaming to fallback smaller model for >1MB prompts.

mia: can flip `preproc.template_example_limit` quickly via console, safe toggle. Also we can turn on `preproc.skip_example_render=true` for 10m for noisy customers.

raj: fallback model routing: set policy to `model: small-gen` for requests where `input_bytes>1_000_000` or `rendered_length>30000` — cheaper but maintains availability. We'll still log for evaluation.

pm-anna: are there side effects of skipping example rendering? might change output quality — need to flag to CS/SEs.

sara: agree, include note. prioritize availability over fidelity for short window.

ops-bot: action created: INCIDENT-4150000005 — owners: sara/dave/mia/raj — SLA target: bring p99 under 2s in 30m

dave: rolling the feature flag now. `curl -X POST https://console.internal/flags/preproc -d '{"template_example_limit":20}'`

mia: applied `preproc.template_example_limit=20` to preproc namespace. telemetry: rendered request size median down 35% within 60s

raj: routing rule applied: `if rendered_len > 30000 => model=small-gen` pushed via router v2 at 4150000087

pm-anna: CS notified acme-inc and beta-bank that we're mitigating and will follow up with root cause; asked them to avoid large example uploads for now

ops-bot: metrics update: p99 dropped from ~4.8s to 1.9s at 4150000100, streaming connection failures down to 3%

sara: nice, keep monitoring. next: deep dive to prevent recurrence.

dave: triage notes: hotspot in `TemplateRenderer.renderExamples()` -> uses naive string concat and expands arrays fully. tokenizer receives payloads 2-10x larger than expected.

mia: proposed longer-term fixes: 1) add streaming preprocessor that tokenizes examples incrementally and truncates long expansions with `...` markers, 2) enforce per-request rendered_size limits at gateway, 3) optimize `renderExamples()` to use StringBuilder + streaming writer to reduce GC pressure.

raj: ml-side: add heuristics to not encode large examples inline — instead reference as example_id and fetch lightweight summary during prompting. Also add quantile monitoring on rendered_token_count in telemetry.

pm-anna: follow-up tasks for postmortem: owner assignments?

sara: assign owners: 1) eng-runtime (dave) — implement gateway size guard + routing rules, 2) eng-ml (raj) — prompt renderer heuristics + telemetry, 3) eng-platform (mia) — memory/GC improvements in preproc, 4) CS (pm-anna) — customer comms + outreach. Add timeline + rollback criteria.

ops-bot: note: created Jira EPIC RF-1254 "Tokenizer/preproc JSON-mode tail latency" with tasks RF-1254.1..RF-1254.4

dave: quick patch idea: short-circuit example rendering when examples_count>50 or total_example_chars>200k — can ship as minor release to preproc tomorrow if we want faster fix.

raj: also want to add unit tests covering `{{#each}}` with nested arrays to catch O(n^2) expansion.

pm-anna: CS follow-up: draft message ready, will send once we confirm p99 stable for 15 minutes

sara: monitoring: set anomaly alert for rendered_token_count > 100k and streaming_error_rate > 5% — if it fires, auto-scale preproc by +3 and re-route heavy clients to dedicated capacity where configured

mia: logs + flamegraphs saved under s3://redwood-incidents/4150000005/ for postmortem.

ops-bot: update: p99 holding ~1.8s for last 10m at 4150000205 — mitigation successful. closing pager, leaving incident open for postmortem.

sara: thanks all — handing off to follow-up owners. I'll write incident summary and postmortem template. please add any missing notes to the ticket. :white_check_mark:

pm-anna: adding final note: customer impact: acme-inc experienced degraded streaming for 9m window, beta-bank for 6m, both reported no data loss. action: follow-up call scheduled with acme-inc tomorrow 14:00 PST.

sara: closing thread.
